t: Why he told them not to arrive unannounced
a: أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى تَدْخُلُوا لَيْلاً ـ أَىْ عِشَاءً ـ لِكَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ
p: Amhilū ḥattā tadkhulū laylan, li-kay tamtashiṭa-sh-shaʿithatu wa tastaḥidda-l-mughībah
m: Wait until you enter at night, so that the one with unkempt hair can comb it and the one whose husband has been away can prepare herself.
